_comment: Semgrep scan policy for YecWallet (contrib/semgrep/README.md). The rule packs and the 0xdea audit_rules reasoning follow the node lines' (ycash-dd contrib/semgrep/config.json); paths, accepted findings and local rules are this repository's own.

rule_sources.name: semgrep-rules
rule_sources.license: Semgrep Rules License v1.0: free, for our own use; fetched at scan time, never copied in, never quoted in PRs

audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-typos: Spelling-level C idioms (e.g. '=' vs '=='); -Wall already warns; same reasoning as the node lines
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-interesting-api-cal: Lists every call to memory/string APIs as a starting point for manual review, not a defect
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-signed-unsigned-con: Every signed/unsigned mix (Qt's int sizes against size_t); nearly all intended
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-suspicious-assert: Every assert() with a side-effect-looking argument; review lead only
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-high-entropy-assign: Hard-coded constants (stylesheet colours, test vectors) look like secrets; generic.secrets and gitleaks cover real ones
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-use-of-source-size-: memcpy sized by the source; review lead only
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-pointer-subtraction: Every pointer difference; review lead only
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-integer-truncation: Every narrowing assignment (qint64 -> int in Qt model code); review lead only
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-argv-envp-access: Every argv/getenv read (QCommandLineParser, YELLOWBACK_DEVNET_DIR in tests)
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-write-into-stack-bu: Every write into a local array; review lead only
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-missing-return: The compiler already errors on it (-Werror=return-type)
audit_rules.0xdea.rules.c.raptor-mismatched-memory-m: Every new/delete pairing; Qt widgets are owned by their QObject parent, so a bare new without delete is the Qt ownership idiom; review lead only
